title: Dagrion's Util
description: Multiples hud and tooltips that can be useful
body:
> This is a small mod I made that add the possibility to see *Saturation* and *Toughness*
> 
> It also add the possibility to see the food and saturation given by food.
> 
> I don't know if it useful but I also added the possibility to see the extra armor, for mod that add more than 20 armor points ( I in fact didn't tested it with other mod...)
> 
> Its also supposed to show the extra health bar in a single one, in order to not have half of the screen covered

> All the options can be turned **On** and **Off** in the options `keybind : U` (can be changed)

> There is also a Gamerule that is supposed to remove the abbility to run when low life, like when low food but it's very glichy (/gamerule LowLifeNoSprint)

> It also add a Dev Tool that is pretty Useful, it can :
>- add or set armor
>- add or set toughness
>- add or set health

That is pretty much all the mod add for now
